title: Start circuit orders in Signing, not Day-1
body: Network circuits took 120-170 days. Orders placed after signing put two sites at risk of missing Day-1. Place carrier orders as soon as site scope is known.

title: Warehouse system cut-over needs a peak-season freeze window
body: Retail logistics cut-overs must avoid festive peak. Plan exits for low-volume weeks and agree the freeze window early.
